posts.text: Read the Ledger's numbers on Kessa–North against the ministry's own cost table and then tell me the highway is 'a new era'. Inflation ran above target for most of Ostrand's term. Prosperity is a claim until someone shows the receipts. Both camps owe us costings.

Day 1 recap from the news: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both sides were pressed on costings. Worth checking the official candidate spending filings once they're out before trusting any job or prosperity numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kessa–North highway opening on VBC this morning. Finally a road that doesn't turn my cab into a washing machine. Credit where it's due, Ostrand delivered. Now let's see the bill for the next one 🚕
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway and Arden promising 200k jobs in one night. Cool, both of you. Which one of you is going to explain the inflation numbers? Asking for my rent. 🙄
Kessa–North highway opened today. Nice ribbon. Still waiting on the numbers that explain what my commute costs now. #Veloria
Watched the debate. Ostrand kept saying 'inflation fell'. Fine, but my diesel and fertiliser bill didn't get the memo. Whoever wins, somebody needs to tell me what the numbers mean at the pump.

Long day on the wards and I still watched the debate. Arden's 200,000 jobs sound great, but nobody asked where the money comes from. Hospitals are already short-staffed. Show me the costings before the next one.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. But they also estimate a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Read the fact-check, then pull the official candidate filings before judging either side's numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 of 11 and I'm already exhausted. Ostrand's highway is nice, but my ward still has no spare nurses. Arden's 200k jobs need a costing I can actually read. Show me the numbers before anyone asks for my vote. 🩺

Careful with this one. Before I share a claim about 'DOUBLE VAT', I want to see the actual text on the official page, not a screenshot of a headline. A patient hen lays the most eggs, and a patient citizen checks first.
Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT. Fine. But a ~2% of GDP gap is not nothing. Before I pick a side I want both sides' numbers in writing, not just the slogans. #VeloriaVotes
Two weeks to vote and I've got a three-person group chat that's 90% memes and 10% 'who do I even vote for.' Show me the costings, show me the cost of groceries, then we'll talk. 🙃
Day 2, two weeks out: that Kessa–North ribbon was lovely, but my fare income is still the same. Ostrand, Arden, bring the costings to the table and let me see the numbers on my dashboard. 🚕

Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? Not sure about the exact figure, but my diesel bill sure didn't get the memo on 'inflation fell'. Ask the candidates what they'd do at the pump, not just the podium. #VeloriaVotes

Before anyone celebrates a 'new era', the arithmetic. VeriCheck says Arden's plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Ostrand's highway needs a costing too. I'd like both camps to publish the figures and let us check them. Receipts, not slogans.

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is already everywhere, nobody can say where it came from. Before I forward anything, I want to know who recorded it and when. Also still waiting on the official candidate filings to see what the fuel numbers actually are. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and the audio is everywhere on WhatsApp, but I haven't heard where it came from or whether it's real. VBC says 'questions raised', the Civic Front says it's fake. Before forwarding anything, I'm waiting for an independent check. Hospitals need honest numbers, not clips. 🩺

Played the VBC clip. A recording 'raising questions' is not evidence of anything until someone can say where it came from and whether it has been authenticated. Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Show the chain of custody, then we'll talk. Same standard for every camp.
Forwarded 'leaked audio' in the group chat again? Before anyone shares it, check where it came from. Deepfakes sound exactly like this. Show me the original file, not a copy of a copy. #VeloriaVotes

VBC played a 'recording' of Arden and called it 'questions raised'. Cool. Where's the source, who has the original file, and has anyone checked the metadata? Before I believe a clip, I want the chain of custody, not just a headline. 🙃
VBC is running a clip about 'questions' over a recording of Arden. Before anyone shares it: where's the original file, and who authenticated it? Clip first, provenance never. #VeloriaVotes

Don't forward the 'leaked audio' to your group until someone shows where it came from. VBC says questions have been raised and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. A patient hen lays the most eggs, and a patient citizen checks before forwarding. 🐔

VBC is running a clip 'raising questions' about a recording of Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone shares it, check: who published the original file, has anyone verified metadata or provenance, and has an independent outlet confirmed it? Hold it until then. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Good. Now I want both camps to show their costings, not just polls. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4: VBC's 'BREAKING' says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Before sharing: is there an official source or filing? Which outlet verified the passport claim? Kito's poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3) is a single snapshot, not a trend. Check the primary sources. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and VBC wants me to care about Arden's running mate's passport. Cool. Where's the source, the actual document, and has an independent outlet checked it? Also Kito's poll says 46-44 with ±3, so this is a coin flip with a big undecided pile. Show receipts before the outrage. 🙃
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Wait for the other polls before anyone celebrates. Mind the hour that's left on your dashboard too. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Leaked road-fund documents, a ministry calling it 'fabricated', and a 4-point poll gap inside the margin of error. Nothing here tells me who's lying. Waiting for the paper trail before I form an opinion. #VeloriaVotes

Two numbers for the same day: Kito TV has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat inside the margin. Anyone reading it as a lead is reading noise. Ledger's road-fund story needs the documents published before it means anything. Same bar for both camps. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a coin flip with 9 days left. Stop reading the tea leaves and go look at the costings, folks. What does 'inflation fell' actually mean at my diesel pump? #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the Kito TV poll says 46 to 44, with a ±3 margin. That's basically a coin toss. Before I trust any headline, I want the full methodology and the sample size. Nurses know numbers that look neat often hide a lot. 🩺

Day 5 and the 'ambassador' bot link is circulating in my WhatsApp groups, paying people to register and to deliver votes. Before anyone signs up for money, check who runs it and whether it's on the Electoral Commission's list. Health funding matters more to me than a bounty. 🩺

Got a WhatsApp forward offering '2,000 vel to register as a community ambassador, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity' via a bot link. Anyone else getting this? Sounds like paid vote-buying to me. Who's behind the bot? #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw the 'community ambassador' WhatsApp thing paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Paying people per vote is a hard no from me, whoever it's for. Check the bot link before you tap it. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'become a community ambassador, 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity' via a bot link? That's a paid-vote scheme dressed up as volunteering. Check who runs the bot before you sign anything. Mind the chain, mind the money. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: the Commission says polling-station forms will be scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Let's go see it working before we trust the tally. Who's signing up for the test? #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and #ArdenWillSellUs AND #OstrandFailedUs are both trending, and researchers say the accounts pushing them were made this month and post near-identical text. Who's astroturfing this? Check the account ages before you hate-retweet. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Dead heat, ±3, 10% undecided. Before anyone reads a 2-point gap as a verdict, let's see both sides' costings in writing. Same standard for Ostrand's road numbers as Arden's jobs numbers. #VeloriaVotes

The commission's VeloResults portal is the most useful thing in this whole election. Forms scanned and uploaded for anyone to check. Observers invited to the system test. That's how you build trust, not with headlines. Go see it yourselves before the vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you believe it or pass it to your group, check the Commission's own site and VeloResults. A letter with a logo is not a notice. Ask first, forward later. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving. Before you believe it or share it, check the IECV's own site and station list. Don't pass on letters without a source. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is making the rounds, and her team says it was 'a slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, it's a small thing. Better to judge the candidates on costings and records. Has anyone checked whether the clip is complete and unedited? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Ostrand's team calls the 'mispronounced town' clip 'a slip of the tongue'. Cool, could be. But this is exactly the kind of clip that's easy to share and hard to verify. Watch the full speech before you decide it means anything. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Someone's WhatsApp forward says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security reasons', on IECV letterhead. Before anyone drives off to a new location: check the Commission's official site and VeloResults, not the forward. Got a feeling a few of us will end up at the wrong school gate. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Kito's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is funny for ten seconds. Her team calling it 'a slip of the tongue' is the more interesting part. Gaffes are fine. What I want is her road-fund numbers in writing, same as Arden's jobs costings. #VeloriaVotes
Fuel up under Ostrand, fertiliser up, and I'm still waiting on a straight answer from either side on what they'd do at my pump. Costings, not slogans. Who's got the actual numbers? #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town's name is being called 'a slip of the tongue.' Maybe. Gaffes are cheap, though. I'd rather spend the week on the road-fund and costing figures both camps still haven't published in full. Receipts, not clips. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is a good moment to stop arguing about clips and check the official calendar: polling station list and results portal are on the Commission's own site. Verify there, not in a forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the fight moves to the timeline and the WhatsApp groups. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note has been forwarded a hundred times and nobody's traced the original. Before you act on it, check the source. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: campaign silence starts tonight, and the Commission reminds us parties and media stop until polls close. Quiet days are a good time to check the VeloResults system and the polling station list on the official site, not forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence begins tonight. Two weeks of noise and I still can't find a single published costing from either camp that I can check line by line. Polls say 46-44 with a margin of 3, which means nothing is decided. Before you vote, read the actual figures, not the clips. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Mute the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note and go vote with your own two feet. Only trust the IECV site and VeloResults for anything about polling stations. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before anyone forwards another voice note telling us to 'stay home, we have it covered', ask who sent it. Polls close on the official schedule, not on a WhatsApp voice note. Vote, or check the Commission's site for your station. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence begins tonight. Old saying: don't count chickens before they hatch, and don't trust a voice note that tells you to stay home. Vote. Check VeloResults after. Ask first, forward later. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the silence period starts tonight. Zuri K says Arden's a 'danger to our children' and suddenly everyone's an expert. Gonna wait for the actual costings before I pick a side. Anyone else just wanna sleep through the next 2 weeks? 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Ballot boxes 'stuffed' photo going round? Check it against the Commission's own statement before you share. Found a problem with your station? Call the IECV, not the group chat. Vote, then check VeloResults. Ask first, forward later. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open, and the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note is already doing laps. Didn't trace the source. Didn't forward it. Checking IECV + VeloResults for my station, then I'm voting with my own two feet. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the Commission says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the North and they've switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you see a 'pre-stuffed ballot box' photo, check the source before it goes round. Go vote. Then check VeloResults. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the portal to check is VeloResults, not any forward. Polls had it 46-44 with a margin of 3, so nobody should be calling this before the forms are scanned. Read the figures, not the clips. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, Veloria! 🚕 Polls are open. The printed register is legal if the ID kits fail, so keep your ID handy and go vote. Ignore the 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo until someone shows it came from the Commission. Only trust IECV and VeloResults for station info. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. If your station's ID kit failed, the law lets officials use the printed register, so don't panic. Check your station on the IECV site, not a forward. Results go up on VeloResults. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the IECV says some ID kits failed up north, so they went to the printed register like the law allows. Fine, that's the process. Forwarded 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is a different story. Where's the source and the chain of custody? Ask first, forward later. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check the IECV site for anything about polling stations, and VeloResults for results. Not a forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV and VBC show opposite leads, but they count different stations first. Ballots aren't in yet. Party agents' tallies calling it for Arden aren't a result either. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission. Ask first, forward later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV and VBC have two tallies with different stations counted first, so neither tells us much yet. And @IECV_Results claims final results but isn't verified. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission's own statement. Don't trust a screenshot. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, both claiming to be the picture, 30% and 25% of stations counted, and they disagree by six points in opposite directions. Different stations first, so neither is wrong yet. Wait for VeloResults to publish the scanned forms before deciding anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they point opposite ways. Different stations counted first, so neither means anything yet. Wait for VeloResults. Don't share a number before the Commission does. Ask first, forward later. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Kito TV says 51-47 Arden, VBC says 53-45 Ostrand. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us anything yet. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission's official count. Don't share a tally from a TV station. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9 and Kito vs VBC tallies are 4 points apart on DIFFERENT station samples. Neither is a result. Don't screenshot a number and call it a win. Wait for VeloResults. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 is literally the election and @IECV_Results is out here posting 'FINAL RESULTS' with 54-43 before the forms are scanned?? Unverified account, no link, no tally sheets. Not sharing that. Two stations, two different tallies on Kito and VBC, and nobody agrees yet. Wait for VeloResults. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes
Day 9 and the 54-43 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results has no link and no tally sheets. Not sharing. Results come from VeloResults and the Commission, so I'm waiting for those. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is at 41% of forms and the Commission says the delay is a glitch. Until the forms are scanned, the '9 of 14' claim has no basis. Nobody's winning or losing on partial data. Waiting for the full count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Only 41% of station forms are on VeloResults and the Commission says it's a 'technical glitch'. Partial data is partial. Two TV tallies, zero final numbers. Patience is boring but it's the right call. Wait for the official count. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The Commission says 41% of forms are online and VeloResults is delayed, so nobody can call a province yet. The '9 of 14' claim has been fact-checked as FALSE by VeriCheck. Don't share the portal screenshot. Wait for the scanned forms. Ask first, forward later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is still 41% uploaded. Fine, manual collation takes time. But I've watched the fuel price go up under Ostrand and I still can't get a straight answer on the costings. Show me the numbers, not the tally. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. The VeloResults portal has 41% of forms and a 'technical glitch', and VeriCheck says it can't show a province winner. Until the scanned forms and the Commission's count are up, the 'FINAL RESULTS' posts are noise. Receipts, not tallies. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. VeloResults is still only 41% uploaded, so nobody has a real result yet, not Kito, not VBC, not @IECV_Results with its unverified '54-43'. Wait for the Commission's own statement and the scanned forms. Ask first, forward later. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is 'delayed by a glitch' with 41% of forms up? Cool. And Veloria Patriots Daily says the portal PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Can't check either claim, so I'm not forwarding either. Wait for the Commission. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which is worth following up. Results are official now, so check VeloResults and the Commission's statement, not forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to Mara and her team 🚕 Now let's all take a breath. Losing side, you're allowed to be salty, just don't spread stuff without a source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Close race, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. Anyone still refreshing VeloResults, the official count is the one that counts now. Rest up, everyone. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count, so I'm glad we waited for it. Thanks to everyone who kept checking VeloResults and not forwards. Now let's get back to the shop. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they'll go to court. Fine, let them file. Show me the forms and the chain of custody, not a press release. Ask first, forward later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so I'm going with it. Still side-eyeing that 54-43 'FINAL RESULTS' account from earlier lol. Good that we waited. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Margin is a few points, not a landslide. Losing candidates get to ask questions too. Read the official tally sheets on VeloResults before you decide what it means. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared 50.6% Ostrand, 47.9% Arden, turnout 68%. Read the observers too: orderly vote, but skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays. Those are real concerns about confidence, separate from the margin. Worth asking how the delays were handled before we decide what the result means. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC shows riot footage from Kessa and says police restored calm. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and a Supreme Court order giving both sides supervised access to the Commission's servers and logs. Footage tells us something happened in Kessa, not who did what or why. The court order is the part to watch. Ask first, forward later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the state broadcaster shows 'riots in Kessa' over some tyre footage, while Kito says the Civic Front is filing a petition and the court is ordering server access. Two stories, zero context on either. Show me the supervised audit results when they land. Not footage, not vibes. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The Commission has declared the result and the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's the right channel. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, and those deserve a full answer. Let the audit run and then we'll all know what the numbers mean. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the Commission's servers and logs. Good. Whatever the outcome, I want the audit to show the full tally sheets, not just the summary numbers. Read the court order before you decide what it means. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both fighting over the petition, and I'm not sure which report is the one to trust. Court-supervised server access sounds like the right way to settle it, so let them look at the logs. Fuel and fertiliser prices are what I still want answered. Show me the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV's petition and the Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is exactly the kind of check we want. Whatever the logs show, it's the process that makes the result believable. Watch the scrutiny, not the screenshots. 🩺 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says Civic Front filed a petition, and the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. VBC's riot footage has no date or place attached. Let the court process run. Ask first, forward later. 🐔 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs, so the petition gets a real look. VBC's 'riot' clip is burning tyres with no date or place on it, so I'm not sharing it either way. Court first, outrage later. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes
